<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 182.073, the likely ion is [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 181.066 Da. The formula C₉H₉O₄ matches this mass closely (exact neutral mass 181.050 Da, [M+H]⁺ 182.057 Da), which is the best fit among reasonable C/H/O combinations. No other heteroatoms appear necessary.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9O4</final_answer>
